name: Julie
summary: A sweet young girl who has been through a lot, now healthy and ready for a loving home.
story:
Julie was found thrown out on the street, pregnant and very thin. Her owners did not want her anymore. She was only about 7 months old when she was pregnant, and sadly she lost her babies.

We rescued her and helped her get strong again. Today Julie is under 2 years old, still young and gentle, and she lives with other cats at home.

She truly deserves a family who will love her and never let her go.
